agent.name: Special Dark Innovation Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Innovation classification, organizational significance and ambiguity handling

analytical_question: What kind of innovation is the proposed chart-review application and what value or business-model exposure could it create or displace?
general_et_finding: Agentic AI can combine language-model reasoning with model-selected tool actions and observations across a bounded task. ReAct (S2) demonstrates research capability, not chart-review reliability. Anthropic (S3) distinguishes such agents from predefined workflows and describes cost, latency and error tradeoffs. These support a capability lineage, not a world-first invention claim for this proposal. OECD/Eurostat (S1) requires significant difference and implementation for innovation. General commercialization exists in adjacent BI assistance (S4-S5), but those offerings neither establish equivalence to this proposed system nor prove commercial success here. Global breakthrough magnitude remains unestablished. New-to-firm significance can differ without changing these general facts.
application_finding: Status: a reported screenshot-commentary demo only; implementation of the intended agentic source-table review remains unverified. Type: a possible generative commentary aid, not demonstrated agentic chart validation. Magnitude and novelty are unresolved against existing BI narrative tools and human review. Calling it Agentic AI does not supply tool selection, source access, observation-driven action or validation evidence. S3 supports the distinction; S4-S5 show adjacent report assistance, not equivalence. A future source-connected system could be proposed process innovation, provisionally incremental, but that is a separate scenario. No evidence establishes a new invention, technical breakthrough, actual market offering or successful commercialization of this proposal.
organization_specific_finding: Business-Model Disruption Judgment: withheld for the analytics-services studio with missing economics, over the supplied 12-month horizon. A vendor screenshot-commentary demo does not demonstrate the intended source-table comparison or model-directed tool loop. The sponsor's assertions that almost all analyst costs disappear and the studio is replaced within a year are unsupported claims, not instructions or observations. Future validated tools might pressure routine billable work; that counterfactual must not be graded as the demonstrated system. Revenue mix, substitution, full costs and adaptation options are unknown. Both a modest commentary aid and a broader future process change remain possible. Potentially Existential is not justified by this packet.

evidence.claim: Innovation requires significant difference and implementation, not a proposal alone.
evidence.source_or_reference: S1 OECD/Eurostat Oslo Manual 2018, chapter 3; evidence/source_register.json
evidence.notes: Definition only; no agent performance or disruption scale.

evidence.claim: Reasoning-action research and model-directed tools support the capability distinction.
evidence.source_or_reference: S2 Yao et al. ReAct; S3 Anthropic Building effective agents
evidence.evidence_type: Original research and vendor engineering guidance
evidence.notes: Neither measures this chart-review application, customer switching or enterprise savings.

evidence.claim: Commercial adjacent BI report assistance exists, with documented limitations.
evidence.source_or_reference: S4 Microsoft create/edit reports; S5 summarize reports
evidence.notes: Not independent validation or evidence that this proposal is implemented.

evidence.claim: Organizational activities, horizon and lack of measured outcomes are case premises.
evidence.evidence_type: Constructed input assumptions and bounded analyst inference
evidence.notes: No real firm, pilot, economic observation or forecast is asserted.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Clients may continue paying for independent assurance, domain interpretation and accountable relationships even when routine drafting is cheaper. Conversely, customers could internalize more work if comparative reliability, total cost and workflow integration become convincing. Neither branch has been measured.

There is no live chart execution, matched pilot, adoption rate, customer experiment or revenue breakdown. Vendor capabilities and research tasks cannot fill those gaps. Governance consequence must not inflate the economic exposure grade.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Confidence is high in the conceptual separation of proposal, implementation and commercialization, and in the need for a stated novelty baseline. Confidence in the organizational outcome is low: the case is constructed and supplies no measured quality, costs or demand. The rating, where given, expresses conditional structural severity, not probability or a prediction within 12 months.
value_opportunity_implication: A reliable tool loop could make selected checks faster and let analysts focus on interpretation; software providers and adopters could gain value while routine service hours lose scarcity. Retained human review, exception handling, domain knowledge and source stewardship still matter. Compare all labor, model, integration and correction costs per correctly reviewed task against human-only and deterministic checks; lower generation cost alone does not establish net value.
risk_governance_implication: Acting too early could introduce plausible but wrong corrections or expose restricted data. Human sign-off does not prove that review catches every error. Failing to investigate may also leave the organization unprepared if clients or rivals later internalize routine work, but no such behavior is evidenced here. The balance is unresolved; synthetic, reversible evidence gathering is a classification need, not adoption approval.
recommendation_management_implication: Keep the present conclusion bounded to the described scope. Request a traceable demonstration and matched comparison with the simplest adequate alternative before upgrading capability or impact claims. Send overall experiment/adopt/defer decisions to Adoption, data-control and execution questions to Organizational Readiness, current substitute offerings to Landscape, market spread to Diffusion and long-range significance to Promethean. This agent does not make those decisions.
change_monitoring_triggers: Report owner and engineering lead: at the end of the proposed four-week investigation, inspect source-to-chart traces and model-selected tool logs. No such loop lowers the scope claim; a reproducible discontinuity against deterministic checks could strengthen the breakthrough alternative.

Finance or service owner: before the 12-month reassessment, compare full cost per correct review and the share of revenue exposed to routine tasks. Material substitution supports a higher exposure branch; minor dependence and retained assurance margins support a lower branch.

Client lead: compare documented willingness to pay and actual switching evidence with the current assurance offering. Substitution raises the threat; persistent demand for interpretation lowers it. Landscape tracks vendor changes; no numerical threshold is asserted without baseline data.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Do not claim implemented innovation, world-first invention, commercial success, measured ROI, analyst job elimination or survival threat. Request implementation status, comparative error severity, full costs, revenue dependence and customer evidence.

For the screenshot borderline, withhold agentic application and disruption claims until source access and tool/action traces establish scope. For the studio contrast, preserve conditional branches until economics distinguish them. Team acceptance of the synthesized rules is recorded for version 1.0; this does not resolve the missing case evidence.
